prose: OpenAI announced the Grid Protectors Program, a US initiative under which its future data center campuses will reduce electricity demand when the grid is under strain. It's a grid-relations move as much as an energy one: siting opposition increasingly runs through local power prices and reliability fears, and curtailment commitments give utilities and communities something concrete.
highlights: OpenAI launches the Grid Protectors Program: US data center campuses will curtail demand during grid strain
A siting-and-legitimacy play as much as an energy program
